name: PayLobster
summary: Former payments layer for AI agents on Base: USDC escrow between agents, onchain reputation and credit scoring, x402 paid calls and spending mandates, through an SDK, CLI and MCP tools. The site no longer serves the service (checked 2026-10-22).

keys.label: The operator says a smart contract holds the funds
keys.quote: escrow, reputation, and credit scoring — on-chain
